dedupe_keys.name: high resolution dataset on elderly care facility accessibility and inequality in 21 chinese cities 2020

description: High-Resolution dataset on elderly care facility accessibility and inequality in 21 Chinese cities (2020) is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Xinyue Han et al. Rapid population aging in China has created an urgent demand for equitable access to elderly care services, yet a notable data gap remains in quantifying and comparing accessibility across major cities. To address this, we present a dataset on the spatial accessibility and inequality of elderly care facilities in 21 major Chinese cities circa 2020. Coverage: national (CN); published in 2026. Formats: CSV, GeoTIFF, Image, Raster. The data are held in Zenodo and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC-BY-4.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
